findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_devices, get_device_notes, download_preset · Private data: get_amp, compare_amps, download_preset, get_rig · Public sink: find_modeler_equivalent, download_preset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_devices, get_device_notes, download_preset · Private data: get_amp, compare_amps, download_preset, get_rig · Public sink: find_modeler_equivalent, download_preset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
